---
title: Guides
description: "Complete authoring, integration, styling, and publishing tasks with quarto-gradio."
---

Each guide starts from the same model: Quarto renders Python source into an HTML page, then the reader's browser starts the Gradio app. Begin with the [Quickstart](get-started/) if you have not rendered an app yet.

## Author the app

- [Build a Coding Playground](enable-coding-playground/) adds a Python editor and preview for readers.
- [Install Python Packages](customize-python-modules/) covers document requirements, Micropip, pinning, and Pyodide compatibility.
- [Define Multiple Apps](define-multiple-apps/) explains source segments and worker isolation.
- [Match Document Styles](customize-styles/) separates app color mode from Quarto and Python Gradio themes.

## Integrate a source or output format

- [Use a Jupyter Notebook](use-with-jupyter/) renders notebook code cells into an HTML app.
- [Use Reveal.js](use-with-revealjs/) places an app or coding playground on presentation slides.

## Publish

- [Publish to Static Hosting](publish/) identifies the generated files, network access, Content Security Policy, and post-deployment browser checks.

Use the [Configuration Reference](../reference/) for exact option lookup and [Troubleshooting](../reference/troubleshooting.qmd) when a render or app startup fails.
